title: Honest Government Ad | Anti Encryption Law
summary: A satirical 'honest' government ad from The Juice Media about Australia's 2018 Assistance and Access anti-encryption bill. It lays out in blunt terms what the law would let authorities do.
why: Commenters recommend it as an entertaining, accessible explanation of how bad the law is, including for non-technical audiences.

quote.text: It's very entertaining, and explains it in a way that everyday people can understand how bad it will be.
